text:
ashley: Heads-up — seeing a spike of 500s on /api/generate starting ~09:12 UTC. Support says customers are getting errors but the incident bot didn't page. Anyone oncall?
kevin: I'm oncall, grabbing it. sending a manual page now.
kevin: /page sent (manual) — awaiting ack.
ops-bot: automation: attempted auto-page -> ERROR: webhook response 403 (signature_verify_error). Auto-page suppressed per integration policy.
june: we did a signing-key rotation this morning at 06:12 but I only updated the rotator. I didn't push the new secret into ops-config. Oops — investigating.
lia: Customer impact: two customers filed incidents (CS-921, CS-922). One reported an outage for ~4m. Marking P1 until we confirm no further impact.
ashley: ops-bot shows suppress_rules matched `integration-signature-failed` and `auto-suppress: true`. Why would that match for a legit alert?
ops-bot: debug dump (sanitized):
```
POST /hooks/pagerflow
headers: {"X-Signature": "v2=...", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
response: 403 {"error":"signature mismatch"}
suppress_reason: "integration-signature-failed"
```
kevin: Can someone confirm the secret name in k8s? I can patch to unblock if june pushes the value.
june: secret name is `pagerflow/signing-key` in namespace `ops`. I just pushed the correct base64 value and applied a rolling restart for the webhook deployment. PR: https://github.com/redwood/ops-config/pull/432 (patch: add missing secret backfill).
kevin: re-triggering handshake via curl to verify (sanitized):
`curl -X POST https://hooks.internal/pagerflow -H 'X-Signature: v2=correctsig' -d '{"alert":"/api/generate 5xx"}'` -> 200 OK
ops-bot: automation resumed. auto-page now sent and acknowledged by oncall rota.
lia: Confirmed customer #A reported recovery; CS tickets updated with timeline. I'll prepare customer comms after postmortem.
ashley: Good catch. Action items: 1) add a post-deploy smoke test that verifies webhook signatures for rotations, 2) add a monitoring alert if pagerflow returns >=3 consecutive 4xx/5xx in 60s, 3) run a one-off to backfill secrets for recent rotations. Assigning to june for the roll-forward.
june: acknowledged, will own follow-ups and write the remediation playbook.
kevin: thanks all — oncall clear. Leaving notes in the incident runbook (inc-1373).
ops-bot: NOTE: during suppression window (09:12-09:19) 3 alerts were suppressed. Logged to /var/log/incidentbot/suppressed.log for audit.
ashley: I'll draft the short postmortem and include the timeline + customer impact.
